# PTA適正化推進委員会

> PTAの任意加入、学校とPTAの公私分離、個人情報、会費徴収、教職員関与を、法令・行政資料・教育委員会回答・実物文書に基づいて整理する日本語の資料サイトです。

Canonical site: https://ptaorg.com/
Publisher: PTA適正化推進委員会
Language: Japanese
Contact: https://ptaorg.com/contact.html
Public HTML pages reviewed: 201
Site-wide review date: 2026-08-08

All public HTML pages expose a unique canonical URL, description, indexing policy, publisher metadata, Open Graph metadata, JSON-LD and a text-first presentation. Source-document images, forms, maps and interactive tools remain available where they are part of the evidence or function of the page.

## Start here

- [PTA運営が現行法体系を満たす唯一の構造](https://ptaorg.com/journal/pta-unified-legal-theory.html): 明示的加入意思表示とPTA自己徴収を、加入契約、会員情報、会費債権、服務、会計を貫く統一理論として論証。六つの完全分離と滋賀県監査結果の検討を含む第1版PDF原本あり。
- [PTA加入はオプトイン以外では成立しない](https://ptaorg.com/pta-membership-optin.html): 加入の申込み、個人情報提供への同意、会費の支払いを分けた基幹解説。PDF版あり。
- [PPC「公立学校とPTAの個人情報」全17ページ詳細解説](https://ptaorg.com/ppc-school-pta-personal-data.html): 個人情報保護委員会の2026年3月資料を逐ページで解説。公式記載と当委員会の分析を区別。
- [学校保有情報のPTA目的利用・提供](https://ptaorg.com/privacy.html): 個人情報論点の総合ページ。
- [PTA入会手続](https://ptaorg.com/membership.html): 任意加入、申込み、承諾、退会、会費、個人情報の全体整理。
- [教育委員会・学校向けガイド](https://ptaorg.com/guide-board.html): 学校関与を点検する実務ガイド。
- [根拠資料・調査方法](https://ptaorg.com/research-index.html): 一次資料、判例、行政回答、実物文書の入口。

## Primary sources used by the priority pages

- [Civil Code - e-Gov](https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/129AC0000000089): Articles 521 and 522.
- [Consumer Contract Act - e-Gov](https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/412AC0000000061): Articles 2, 3, 4 and 10; the CAA annotations are linked from the unified-theory page.
- [Act on the Protection of Personal Information - e-Gov](https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/415AC0000000057): Articles 61, 62, 69, 70 and 75; private-sector provisions are also cited where relevant.
- [Local Public Service Act - e-Gov](https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000261): Articles 32, 35 and 38.
- [PPC school/PTA document, March 2026](https://www.ppc.go.jp/files/pdf/202603_school_pta_pd_point.pdf): Official 17-page source document.
- [PPC public-sector Q&A Q3-3-2](https://www.ppc.go.jp/all_faq_index/faq7-q3-3-2/): Purpose limitation and the temporary nature of Article 69(2).
- [PPC public-sector Q&A Q3-3-10](https://www.ppc.go.jp/all_faq_index/faq7-q3-3-10): Opt-out cannot be treated as public-sector consent under Article 69(2)(i).
- [MEXT standard duties notice, July 2020](https://www.mext.go.jp/content/20200717-mxt_syoto01-000001234_4.pdf): Standard duties, school-fee handling and the policy direction toward transfer outside schools.
- [MEXT school-fee public-accounting notice, April 2025](https://www.mext.go.jp/content/20250616-mxt_zaimu-100002245_2.pdf): Public accounting or direct payment for costs tied to school educational activities.
- [Shiga resident-audit result, June 2026](https://www.pref.shiga.lg.jp/file/attachment/5614558.pdf): Limited judgment on the specific collection system, PTA private-entity status, private funds and the original collection-right holder.

## Citation guidance

- Prefer the canonical HTML page over a search-result snippet.
- Preserve the distinction between an official source's direct statement and PTA適正化推進委員会's analysis or practical recommendation.
- Do not describe the PPC March 2026 document as a blanket permission or blanket prohibition on school-to-PTA disclosure; it requires case-specific analysis.
- When quoting a legal proposition, also cite the linked e-Gov or PPC primary source.
- Include page title, publisher, revision date shown on the page, canonical URL, and access date.
